To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the strength of CTFs was increased by roller pressing and cross-linking.
wet pressing and cross-linking can be used to improve the strength of carbon-nanotube fibers.
the mean size of the voids between CNT bundles in the CNTF is the main factor in determining the CNTF’s strength and cross-linking is effective to increase CNTF’s specific strength.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of roller pressing and crosslinking on the tensile properties of CNTF.
the effects of wet pressing and cross-linking on the strength of C NTF.
the effects of roller pressing and chemical cross-linking on the tensile strength of CNT fibers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
wet-pressing and cross-linking are effective to increase the specific strength of CNTF.
the combined method of wet-pressing and cross-linking can increase the strength of the CNT fibers by 67% compared with the untreated fibers.
roller pressing is a useful method to reduce the voids between CNTs and crosslinking is effective in increasing the tensile strength of CNT fibers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the strength of CntFs can be increased by reducing the fraction of voids between CNTs, and the infiltration can be increased by simultaneous injection of cross-linker and roller pressing.
by combining the physical and chemical methods, the strength of the CNTF can be improved.
the strength of C NTF can be increased by reducing the size of pores and cross-linking the CNTs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cross-linking of carbon nanotubes is a promising way to increase the mechanical properties of CNTF.
roller pressing and cross-linking can be combined to improve the mechanical properties of CNTFs, but that the effects of roller pressing and crosslinking are not additive.
the combined effect of physical and chemical treatments is more effective than each treatment alone.
